observations: Quest 2 public KGSL source contains distinct A650 and A680 core entries; this does not prove closed userspace supports A680.
A650 GMEM is 1152 KiB; A680 GMEM is 2048 KiB in the inspected source.
A650 uses a650_sqe/a650_gmu; the generic A680 entry uses a630_sqe/a640_gmu. These are source declarations, not permission to replace Surface firmware.
Local Mesa 26.2.4 assigns A650 gen3/3 CCUs and A680 gen2/4 CCUs, with different tile geometry.
Current SQ2 uses MSM DRM, not KGSL; frequency changes do not implement the KGSL userspace ABI.
